annotation.title_clean: 鉄道に関する技術上の基準を定める省令
annotation.title_en: Ministerial Ordinance Establishing Technical Standards for Railways
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japan's MLIT ministerial ordinance setting binding technical standards for railway facilities, vehicles and operation (track, electrical, signalling, rolling stock, inspection, train operation). Only tangential relevance to embodied AI: Article 58 sets requirements for automatic train operation devices on trains without drivers.
key_provisions_or_claims: Railway operators must set and comply with implementation standards notified to regional transport bureaus (Art. 3).
Art. 58: automatic operation devices on driverless trains must confirm passenger safety before departure and stop smoothly.
Art. 86(2): driverless trains need passenger-to-control-centre communication and emergency safety measures.
New or modified facilities and vehicles must be inspected and test-run before use (Art. 88).
Fail-safe requirement for operation safety equipment (Art. 63).
